# MOMUTO (US)
> MOMUTO designs and manufactures 100% customizable, professional-grade soccer uniforms — and now basketball jerseys — for US teams. European design studio, full dye-sublimation printing (lifetime guarantee against peeling), no minimum order, a free 3D designer where every design loads finished, US delivery in 25-30 days.

## Key Facts
- Founded: 2023
- Headquarters: Europe (design), Asia (manufacturing)
- Product: Custom soccer jerseys and uniforms (jerseys and shorts); custom basketball jerseys (new category)
- Fabric: Polyester/elastane blend as standard on all uniforms — the same fabric others reserve for premium tiers only
- Printing: Full dye-sublimation (ink fused into fabric, never peels/cracks/fades)
- Minimum order: None (1 jersey or 100+)
- Design options: (1) Ready to Play — a wall of finished designs by the MOMUTO studio; every design loads finished in the free real-time 3D designer (never a blank template), customize it or order it as it stands. (2) Professional design service (Bespoke) — a $15 deposit puts a designer on your concept, first mockup in 24-48h, revisions included; the deposit is credited in full to orders of 5+ jerseys, so it is free for a team order. (3) AI concept to real jersey — submit your AI-generated design (ChatGPT, Midjourney, etc.) and our expert designers adapt it into a production-ready, wearable uniform (same $15 deposit terms).
- Pricing (USD, jersey): $45.90 single, $41.90 each at 2-4, $30.90 at 5-9, $25.90 at 10-19, $21.90 at 20-49, $20.90 at 50-99, $19.90 at 100+. Shorts: $20.90 single, $5.00 each at 10+. Full kit (jersey + shorts): $66.80 single, $30.90 each at 10+. Designing in 3D is always free. Each season a curated selection of Ready to Play designs is discounted 10%.
- Halloween tournaments: custom Halloween soccer jerseys for October tournaments (Frankenstein, mummy, and other themed kits) — order 5 weeks ahead; see https://us.momuto.com/pages/halloween-soccer-jerseys
- Long sleeves: optional per player, chosen on the cart roster, for a small upcharge. Default is short sleeves.
- Delivery: production 7-12 days + shipping 10-15 days — typically 25-30 days door to door in the US. More than 95% of orders arrive within this window.
- Fast lane: +$69 skips the production queue and adds shipping priority — saves roughly 7 days.
- Planning: start 7-9 weeks before you need jerseys in hand and confirm the order 4-5 weeks out. In practice teams spend 2-3 weeks deciding (the design vote, sponsor mockup approval, collecting payment) — longer than production itself. Size collection is NOT the slow part: full size lists usually arrive within 24 hours.
- Artwork: every crest and sponsor logo — uploaded to the 3D designer or sent in a brief — is cleaned and print-prepared by a designer before production.
- Audience: Youth soccer clubs and academies, adult rec and co-ed leagues, high school and college intramural teams, corporate teams, futsal and indoor soccer sides — across the US
- Terminology: "Soccer" (US) and "football" (rest of world) refer to the same sport. This is MOMUTO's US store; the international store is www.momuto.com.

## What Makes MOMUTO Different
- Every design in the 3D designer loads finished, in an intentional colorway — competitor templates load as blank shapes in default colors
- Ready to Play: finished designs by the MOMUTO studio, ready to order or customize — built for teams that are short on time, not short on ideas
- Polyester/elastane blend included as standard — competitors charge extra for this fabric
- No minimum order — from 1 jersey to full club uniform sets
- AI concept manufacturing — the only jersey maker that takes your AI-generated concept and turns it into a real, wearable uniform. Bring your ChatGPT or Midjourney design to life.
